findings.title: A previous Hello timeout or late callback settles the fresh Hello after reinjection
findings.cause: The gate waits for previous.bridge.ready() to settle, including MAIN's local30s timeout; it does not wait for the corresponding isolated relay entry to terminate. MAIN timeout and relay timeout are both30s, MAIN's timer is installed first. MAIN rejection opens the new Hello before the old relay timeout task runs. SDK_READY_EVENT carries no handshake identity; every current transport waiting under literal hello consumes the old relay event.
findings.strongestCounterexample: After MAIN times out Hello1 and starts Hello2, late Hello1 success with old methods resolves fresh ready() as true. Actual Hello2 E_GRANT_REVOKED is then ignored. In the timer-only variant old relay timeout rejects fresh ready() even though actual Hello2 succeeds.

reproducer.boundary: Actual current entry/window transport/relay with controlled timers/native callback continuations; production/development exact bundles also evaluated in VM. No actual Chrome injection or native worker death.
steps: Install and start Hello1, keep native callback pending.
Re-evaluate fixed MAIN / reinstall same document so Hello2 waits on previous ready.
At30s, run old MAIN transport timeout first; flush Promise microtasks. Hello2 now dispatches.
Either run old relay timeout, or deliver old native Hello1 success while its relay entry is still pending.
Deliver actual Hello2 success for timeout variant, or E_GRANT_REVOKED for stale-success variant.
Observe fresh ready() permanently E_TIMEOUT, or ready=true with the old methods despite new native denial.
reproducer.expected: Only actual Hello2 response can settle the fresh handshake; old relay timers/callbacks cannot supply or deny its readiness.

findings.requiredFix: Bind MAIN/ISOLATED Hello settlement to the actual handshake incarnation and fence all old timer/native continuations across MAIN timeout and reinjection. Preserve the frozen native SDK_HELLO envelope; waiting only for the previous local Promise is insufficient. Keep native denial explicit and do not synthesize ready.
findings.requiredRegression: Compose actual fixed MAIN reevaluation while Hello1 is pending -> old MAIN timeout -> fresh Hello2 dispatched -> old relay timeout / old late success / old late failure -> fresh native success / E_GRANT_REVOKED; assert fresh readiness/methods match only Hello2. Exercise both packaged modes and terminal disposal.
